objective: Maximize validated combined robot score improvement per billed server-on hour; 20h is a ceiling, not a spend target.
cap_includes: Startup, training, evaluation, rendering, exports, backups, downloads and server idle time across all sessions in this round.
h1_seconds_basis: Historical collection+learning median about2.06s at8192env;2.5s is a conservative planning assumption, not live wall-time measurement.

historical_marginal_evidence.limitation: Historical single runs, no extrapolation or training-seed CI; hardware/runtime differ by robot/run.

allocation_rule: Among eligible candidates, rank min(delta_floor,delta_ratio)/actual total server-on hours for the experiment. This is a noisy heuristic, not expected official return or a confidence bound.

adaptive_paths.both_clear: Go2 winner independent scratch up to4500 plus H1 control/winner repeated1000 each with another train seed, only if predicted cost including setup fits8h.
adaptive_paths.go2_clear_only: Go2 independent scratch up to4500; conditional F11 only if both single factors help and its full cost fits8h. Combination screening precedes selecting the scratch reward file.
adaptive_paths.h1_clear_only: H1 independent scratch up to9000; keep original Go2. Verify learning trajectory, do not assume9000 required or always achievable.
adaptive_paths.neither_clear: Stop further training. Use final-validation allocation only as needed; typically stop within8-10h. Early curriculum-limited negatives remain inconclusive.
adaptive_paths.go2_resume_failed: Replace Go2 screen+confirmation stages with two scratch runs, control and one candidate, up to4000 each, full cost <=12.75h; or concentrate on confirmed H1 opportunity. Do not add this path to normal spending.
adaptive_paths.resume_unavailable: Skip short H1 resume pair; reallocate only within total20h to supported scratch runs. No unsupported checkpoint manipulation or environment changes.

limitations: No reliable probability of candidate gains; optimum and official score return cannot be established from current evidence.
Score proxies are calibrated on two policies and do not certify official gains.
Changing train seed while resuming same parent is not independent initialization; H1 repetition is weaker than full scratch replication.
One independent scratch candidate without a new scratch control checks performance, not causal attribution to reward weights.
Reset seeds do not change current fixed terrain geometry; boundary tests remain necessary.
